freshness.stale: Data may be out of date — no successful refresh for over two intervals
freshness.refreshFailed: Refresh failed — showing the last data received

body.unavailable: {{source}} could not be reached, so figures that depend on it are not shown.
body.not_configured: {{source}} is not set up in this environment, so figures that depend on it are not available.

reasons.stalled: Work is stalled and not progressing.
reasons.highErrorRate: The error rate is above its threshold.
reasons.notConfigured: This component is not configured in this environment.
reasons.sourceUnavailable: The source for this check could not be reached.

health.title: System health
health.subtitle: Live probes of every component Atlas depends on, and the alerts firing right now.

overallDescription.operational: Every probed component answered within its limits.
overallDescription.degraded: At least one component is degraded or could not be verified. See the components below.
overallDescription.outage: At least one component is down. See the components below and the Alerts Center.

health.alertCountsImpact: Active alert counts cannot be shown until it answers.

unverified.unknown: Status unknown — the check could not be completed, so this component has not been verified.
unverified.not_configured: Not configured in this environment, so there is nothing to check.

noComponents.title: No components reported
noComponents.description: The health endpoint answered without any component checks.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Every alert Prometheus raised in the selected period, from Alertmanager and Prometheus history.

empty.title: No alerts in this period
empty.description: Nothing matching these filters fired in the selected time range.

unavailable.title: Alert history unavailable
unavailable.description: Neither Alertmanager nor Prometheus answered, so it is not known whether any alerts fired. This is not the same as “no alerts”.

impact.alertmanager: Currently active alerts may be missing from this list.
impact.prometheus: Resolved alert history may be missing from this list.

rule.title: Alert rule
rule.subtitle: Definition, current state and history of this alert rule.
rule.noThreshold: No threshold annotation on this rule
rule.noCurrentValues: The expression currently returns no series — the condition is not met.
rule.prometheusRequired: Not available — Prometheus must answer to show this.
rule.noInstances: No instance of this rule is active.
rule.noTenants: No tenant is named by this alert's labels.

timeline.empty: No events in the selected period.

impact.prometheus: The current value, chart and history cannot be shown.

notFound.title: Alert rule not found
notFound.description: There is no alert rule named “{{rule}}”. It may have been renamed or removed from the monitoring configuration.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.subtitle: Operational metrics across Atlas, grouped by area. Each chart loads when it comes into view.
metrics.impact: Metric series cannot be loaded until it answers.

unavailable.title: Not available
unavailable.body: not instrumented or not scraped yet.

chart.noData: No data points in this period.
chart.ariaLabel_one: {{title}}: line chart of {{count}} series. Use “Show as table” for the values.
chart.ariaLabel_other: {{title}}: line chart of {{count}} series. Use “Show as table” for the values.
chart.moreSeries_one: {{count}} more series is listed in the table view.
chart.moreSeries_other: {{count}} more series are listed in the table view.

configuration.title: Monitoring & alerts
configuration.subtitle: How Atlas is monitored and where alerts are delivered. Rules are version-controlled and read-only here.

scrape.title: Metrics scrape authentication
scrape.description: How Prometheus is allowed to read Atlas's metrics endpoint.

token.label: Bearer token
token.description: Prometheus authenticates with a scrape token. The token itself is never shown here.

platform_owner_only.label: Platform Owner session only
platform_owner_only.description: No scrape token is configured, so the metrics endpoint is readable only by a signed-in Platform Owner.

channels.title: Notification channels
channels.description: Where Alertmanager sends alerts. Counts are Alertmanager's own for the last 24 hours.
channels.notConnectedBody: Alertmanager has no Slack receiver, so alerts are not delivered to Slack.
channels.impact: Its connection and delivery counts cannot be shown.

rules.title: Alert rules
rules.description: The rules Prometheus evaluates. They are defined in version-controlled configuration and cannot be edited here.

synthetic.title: Synthetic test alert
synthetic.description: Checks the whole alert path end to end: a real test alert fires through Prometheus → Alertmanager → Slack and resolves on its own when the time is up.
synthetic.notArmed: Not armed. No test alert is firing.
synthetic.armedTitle: Armed — a test alert is firing
synthetic.minutesInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from {{min}} to {{max}}.

confirmArm.title: Fire a real test alert?
confirmArm.description_one: This fires a real alert through Prometheus → Alertmanager → Slack. Everyone subscribed to the alert channel will be notified. It resolves automatically after {{count}} minute.
confirmArm.description_other: This fires a real alert through Prometheus → Alertmanager → Slack. Everyone subscribed to the alert channel will be notified. It resolves automatically after {{count}} minutes.

confirmResolve.title: Resolve the test alert now?
confirmResolve.description: The test alert stops firing now and a resolved notification is sent through Alertmanager to Slack.

webVitals.title: Real-user performance
webVitals.description: Core Web Vitals from a sample of real visits. Each figure is the 75th percentile (p75): three in four sampled visits were at least this fast. Only the page type and whether the screen is phone-sized are recorded — no addresses, accounts or URLs.
webVitals.empty: No samples in this period. Collection is off unless the frontend build sets VITE_RUM_SAMPLE_RATE and the API sets RUM_ENABLED=true.
